_note: What you see: The information page on enrolling employees: which details are needed, reserving places without names, and moving or cancelling with the deadlines.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De informatiepagina medewerkers inschrijven: welke gegevens nodig zijn, plekken reserveren zonder namen, en verplaatsen of annuleren met de termijnen.
U schrijft een of meer medewerkers in me: You enrol one or more employees with one form. Your employee gets an email with the day, the place and what to bring.
Dit hebben wij van elke deelnemer nodig: What we need from each participant
Exactly as on the ID. That way the name is also right on the certificate.
Alleen bij een cursus met examen. De exa: Only for a course with an exam. The exam body asks for it.
Van de deelnemer zelf. Daarmee logt hij: The participant's own. They use it to sign in to My academy.
Weet u nog niet wie er gaat? Reserveer d: Not sure yet who is going? Reserve the places and fill in the names later. You can until 12.00 on the working day before the course.
Een collega mag altijd in de plaats van: A colleague may always take the place of a sick technician. Pass on the new name in My academy.
Incompany: een eigen cursusdag: In-company: a course day of your own
After the confirmation you get an invoice. It is also in My academy. The payment term is [AANTAL] days.
Sophie van Dam plant de cursusdagen. Zij: Sophie van Dam plans the course days. She knows where there is still room.
